mapper.select: SELECT j.title , u.company_name as companyName , j.salary , j.close_date as closeDate , reg_date FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id WHERE j.post_status = 1 AND j.close_date >= NOW() AND j.reg_date = (SELECT MAX(j1.reg_date) FROM job_posting j1 JOIN user_company u1 ON j1.comp_id = u1.user_id WHERE u1.company_name = u.company_name) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 6

SELECT j.title, u.company_name AS companyName, j.salary, j.close_date AS closeDate FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id WHERE j.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM (SELECT job_id FROM job_application GROUP BY job_id ORDER BY COUNT(user_id) DESC LIMIT 6 ) AS top_jobs)

SELECT j.title, u.company_name AS companyName, j.salary, j.close_date AS closeDate FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id WHERE j.job_id IN ( SELECT job_id FROM (SELECT job_id FROM favorite_company ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 6) AS wishlist)
